Real wages have been trending negative for consumers since April (particularly low and middle-income households). Revolving and non-revolving loans are rising. Non-mortgage personal interest payments now consume 2.5% of disposable income—alarmingly close to the 2.8% threshold that preceded the three pre-COVID recessions.
